remaining_gate: No vanishing of Br(U), no count for nonzero geometric Brauer obstruction, no full local finite-generation conclusion, and no cross-characteristic count is asserted.
gate_subtraction: Extends the existing bounded-scalar local count to arbitrary scalar order when the geometric Brauer obstruction vanishes. Fixed Pic(U)/n generators and fixed-tensor finite jets replace the bounded-order killing subgroup.
